subject: FinAxis pilot cadence and stakeholder roster
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finaxis.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & proposed pilot cadence (next steps)

Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed path to pilot: 

Summary of discovery highlights:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on customer-facing search summaries while keeping latency < 350ms P95.
- Data surface: ~150K monthly user queries, historical logs available in S3 (redacted).
- Success metric: 10-15% unit cost reduction with no more than 2% quality degradation on our evaluation set.

Proposed pilot plan (high level):
1) Kickoff (Week 0): align on success criteria, data access, security checklist.
2) Week 1–3: baseline runs + Redwood model variants (quantization, batching) against test harness.
3) Week 4: readout with decision gate (accept / iterate / extend).

Immediate asks from your side:
- Confirm dataset access (S3 prefix + IAM contact) or alternatively provide a snapshot (CSV) we can use.
- Agree to the three success metrics below so we can lock the SOW and calendar:
  • Latency: P95 < 350ms (region: us-west)
  • Cost: >= 10% improvement vs baseline unit cost
  • Quality: < 2% regression on labeled test prompts

Proposed kickoff windows: Mon Dec 20 10:00–11:00 PT OR Tue Dec 21 09:00–10:00 PT. Please confirm which works or propose another slot.

Attached: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft).

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop Aditya (SE) to propose the evaluation scripts and Marissa (CS) to manage onboarding cadence.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finaxis.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finaxis.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed pilot cadence (next steps)

Thanks Rishi — great summary and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications/questions before we lock dates: 

1) Test data: we can grant a read-only S3 prefix for the engineering team. I’ll need the IAM email contact for provisioning (we prefer scoped roles that expire).
2) Quality metric: the 2% regression threshold is fine, but can you confirm how you measure (per-prompt exact match vs. human-rated relevance)? We’d like to include a handful of blind human checks in Week 4.
3) Data retention & logs: we need confirmation on log retention for the pilot (our compliance team requires 90-day retention by default).

Kickoff: Tue Dec 21 09:00–10:00 PT works for Oliver and me.

If the above looks good I’m happy to sign the draft SOW and we’ll route the IAM request to our infra team.

Best,
Maya
Director of Product, FinAxis

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Evaluation plan + owners for FinAxis pilot

Internal note — capturing the evaluation plan Aditya will own and the handoffs we discussed. Sharing so Marissa/Rishi have an ops-ready checklist.

Outline (detailed):
- Data ingestion (owner: Marissa): confirm S3 prefix, request scoped IAM from FinAxis (expiration 30 days). Will validate sample (max 10k rows) before full access. Attachment: test_data_schema.csv
- Baseline measurement (owner: Aditya): run current model with Redwood default settings to capture cost/latency/quality. Deliverable: baseline_report.md by end of Week 1.
- Variant experiments (owner: Aditya): test 3 configurations — FP16 baseline, 8-bit quantized, and batching with prefix cache. Track per-token cost and P95 latency.
- Human evaluation (owner: FinAxis, coordinated by Marissa): provide 200 blind prompts + human ratings during Week 3–4. We’ll provide the evaluation UI and scoring rubric.
- Weekly cadence: 30-minute standups (Thu 9:30 PT) + async updates in shared Drive.
- Risk/esc: If latency exceeds 400ms P95 on any config, auto-fallback to baseline model and we trigger a joint triage.

I’ll prepare the experiment harness and push the test script to the shared Drive folder by EOD Thu.

Aditya
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: test_data_schema.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finaxis.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed pilot cadence (next steps) — kickoff confirmed

Maya / Oliver — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questions — all good notes. Confirming the agreed items below before I send the calendar invite: 

Agreed success criteria (final):
- Latency: P95 < 350ms (us-west)
- Cost: >= 10% unit improvement vs baseline
- Quality: < 2% regression on the labeled test set + 200 blind human ratings acceptability (FinAxis to provide raters)

Compliance/logs: Redwood will retain pilot logs for 90 days and provide an audit export on request — I’ll route this to our security contacts once we have the S3 prefix.

Kickoff: Tue Dec 21 09:00–10:00 PT (Calendar invite to follow). Agenda: introductions, S3 access & security contacts, success metric definitions, Week 1 targets.

Attachments & links: SOW (draft) in Drive and experiment folder with schema + harness.

Next steps for FinAxis: send IAM provisioning contact + approve SOW by EOD Mon Dec 20.

If that matches your expectation I’ll send the invite and a short calendar prep note for attendees.

— Rishi
